P-MAGRA-INTEGRATION.NAME: MAGRA Integration Decision
P-MAGRA-INTEGRATION.summary: Use DeepSeek-Reasonix as the base product. Integrate MyGRACE as the governance and skill namespace, RTK as the token-optimized shell sidecar, and SNARC as the salience-gated memory subsystem. Do not create four parallel runtimes.

decision.decision-1: Reasonix remains the core loop, CLI, web dashboard, tool host, MCP bridge, sessions, permissions, hooks, skills, and edit gate.
decision.decision-2: MyGRACE becomes a first-class runtime namespace under `/mygrace:*`, backed by Node-compatible MyGRACE services and the canonical skill bodies.
decision.decision-3: RTK stays a Rust sidecar invoked by the Reasonix shell/tool host, with missing-binary fallback and doctor diagnostics.
decision.decision-4: SNARC becomes a local memory service wired into Reasonix tool, prompt, compaction, and stop events, with MCP/tool retrieval exposed to the agent and web UI.

why-this-shape.reason-1: Reasonix already owns the web chat and slash command UX the user wants; replacing it would discard the strongest base.
why-this-shape.reason-2: MyGRACE is primarily methodology, skills, templates, and index navigation; it should govern the Reasonix project rather than compete with its loop.
why-this-shape.reason-3: RTK is strongest as a binary proxy with ecosystem-specific filters; reimplementing it in TypeScript would reduce capability and increase risk.
why-this-shape.reason-4: SNARC complements Reasonix memory because it captures high-salience events and conversation turns with provenance, not just pinned static memory.

proposed-modules.module-1: Imported Reasonix CLI/dashboard/runtime baseline, kept compatible during all phases.
proposed-modules.module-2: Index-first MyGRACE artifact reader/writer for docs/, modules, plans, verification, and source/proposal indexes.
proposed-modules.module-3: Canonical MyGRACE skill registry and command mapping for all 14 skills.
proposed-modules.module-4: Dashboard composer, command palette, and `/api/slash` support for `/mygrace:*` commands.
proposed-modules.module-5: Node-compatible adapter for MyGRACE CLI/MCP behaviors: init, lint, module/phase/verification navigation, file markup.
proposed-modules.module-6: Shell tool RTK auto-prefix, bypass, raw fallback, exit-code preservation, and savings telemetry.
proposed-modules.module-7: SQLite-backed salience memory, scorer, consolidation, search, stats, identity review, and project scoping.
proposed-modules.module-8: Reasonix event adapter for prompt, tool, compaction, and stop memory capture/injection.
proposed-modules.module-9: MCP/native tool exposure for MyGRACE and SNARC capabilities through Reasonix.
proposed-modules.module-10: Shared log markers, verification commands, dashboard health, and regression gates.

data-flow.DF-CHAT-MYGRACE: Web chat composer -> `/api/slash` -> MyGRACE slash handler -> skill body or MyGRACE service -> Reasonix loop/tool registry -> MyGRACE docs update or answer.
data-flow.DF-SHELL-RTK: Agent shell request -> approval gate -> RTK policy -> `rtk ` or raw fallback -> filtered result -> Reasonix log -> RTK savings telemetry.
data-flow.DF-SNARC-MEMORY: Prompt/tool/compaction/stop event -> SNARC scorer/store -> SQLite project DB -> related memory retrieval -> labeled context injection and dashboard/MCP retrieval.
data-flow.DF-MCP: Reasonix MCP bridge -> MyGRACE/SNARC tool adapters -> lazy docs navigation or memory retrieval -> distilled tool result.

web-chat-requirement.requirement-1: Add slash suggestions for all 14 MyGRACE commands in the existing Composer popup.
web-chat-requirement.requirement-2: Add command palette entries for MyGRACE status, lint, skills, and docs navigation.
web-chat-requirement.requirement-3: Expose command metadata through the existing `/api/slash` endpoint rather than a parallel endpoint.
web-chat-requirement.requirement-4: For long-running MyGRACE execute/multiagent flows, reuse Reasonix plan/checkpoint/revision modal patterns.

implementation-phases-proposed.phase-0: Approve this proposal and create graph, plan, and verification per-entity files.
implementation-phases-proposed.phase-1: Import Reasonix base into the managed source tree with minimal renaming and baseline verification.
implementation-phases-proposed.phase-2: Add MyGRACE docs service, CLI adapter, and full `/mygrace:*` slash namespace.
implementation-phases-proposed.phase-3: Add dashboard MyGRACE UX and skill invocation from web chat.
implementation-phases-proposed.phase-4: Add RTK shell policy, doctor checks, and savings UI.
implementation-phases-proposed.phase-5: Add SNARC memory service, loop adapters, MCP tools, and dashboard memory views.
implementation-phases-proposed.phase-6: Run compatibility hardening, contract migration waves, license attribution, and release packaging.

verification-strategy-proposed.check-1: Reasonix baseline: `rtk npm run verify` passes before and after integration phases.
verification-strategy-proposed.check-2: MyGRACE namespace: unit tests assert all 14 `/mygrace:*` commands appear in `/api/slash` and Composer suggestions.
verification-strategy-proposed.check-3: MyGRACE docs: lint tests detect index/per-file drift and reject monolithic artifact creation.
verification-strategy-proposed.check-4: RTK policy: shell tests assert command rewrite, raw fallback, exit-code preservation, and approval behavior.
verification-strategy-proposed.check-5: SNARC memory: SQLite tests assert capture, scoring, search, briefing, compaction capture, and provenance labels.
verification-strategy-proposed.check-6: MCP bridge: integration tests assert MyGRACE and SNARC tools are visible and callable without breaking existing MCP servers.
